blurb: Felix Jauvin is a Montreal-based macro trader and host of the Forward Guidance podcast at Blockworks, where he interviews institutional investors, economists, and strategists on global liquidity cycles, rates, and asset allocation. On X he posts independently under @fejau_inc, covering macro positioning, volatility dynamics, Bitcoin as a global liquidity proxy, and occasional forays into quantitative finance. His public persona straddles two registers: long-form podcast interviewer drawing out guests on yield curve mechanics and central bank balance sheets, and short-form commentator flagging market anomalies, academic papers, and trade setups for a following in the low six figures.
credibility_note: Jauvin speaks as a practitioner-commentator rather than a licensed advisor or disclosed fund manager; his views are not attributable to a regulated entity. He has a track record of surfacing serious academic and market-structure ideas to a broad audience — the implied-volatility tweet is characteristic of his tendency to reframe technical finance questions for non-specialist readers. No verified AUM or auditable performance record is publicly available.
